items.title: Amazon’s new Shop Direct Merchant Workspace makes it even easier for stores across the web to have their products discovered by customers on Alexa for Shopping and Amazon
items.snippet: Tens of millions of customers have already discovered hundreds of millions of products from stores across the web through Amazon’s Shop Direct. With the new Shop Direct Merchant Workspace, merchants have a fast, free direct AI connector from their store to Alexa for Shopping and Amazon.
